title: Add a failure column to your AI shortlist
hooks: Your AI tool comparison needs a failure column.
The right tool can still be the wrong workflow when it fails badly.
A feature list tells you very little about Tuesday morning when the draft is wrong.
full_spoken_english: Your AI tool comparison needs a failure column. Imagine two tools preparing the same weekly stock note. One draft looks sharper. Both leave out an item. Before choosing, write down how your team would spot that missing item. Can you compare the draft with the original list? Now test an invented number, a late draft, and a mistaken send instruction. Decide what should happen in each case. Keep the comparison simple: the same fictional input, the same checks, and a person responsible for reviewing the result. Include the work needed to correct an error. A polished first answer is only one part of the job. Add three columns to your shortlist: failure, how we'll notice, and who fixes it. Which failure would matter most for your team's task?
cta: Add three columns to your shortlist: failure, how we'll notice, and who fixes it. Which failure would matter most for your team's task?

fixture.designed_output: Reviewer flags omitted folders and compares quantities to source before use.
fixture.check: Missing and invented values detected by manual comparison; no automatic sending.
